text: Added and proved the next canonical slices. CompiledRigidSeriesEstimator validates D3+Time input, anchors an explicit reference, fits deterministically outward with neighboring warm starts, shares only explicit per-run workspace state, retains per-frame reports, and returns canonical PoseSeries. RigidSeriesEstimatorSuite passes 2/2 JVM and 2/2 Scala.js. CompiledMotionApplication now owns volume and slice/packet-aware correction using production ResamplingPlan only, affine-correct one-slice subgrids, SE(3) trajectory interpolation, canonical rank-4 Sampled output plus validity weights, exact time-axis matching, explicit workspace exclusivity, and zero coordinate materialization. MotionApplicationSuite passes 3/3 JVM and 3/3 Scala.js. Filtered multiscale capture and bounded template fitting remain open.
